text:
maya singh: Nightly eval alert: 'context-pulse' prompt set shows ~12% failure on quantized-v2. Failures look like instruction tokens getting dropped around ~1800-1900 tokens. Anyone seen this pattern?

josh chen: Can you paste a failing example + eval id?

maya singh: eval-id: nightly/2026-03-19/context-pulse/5482. Here's the tail of the input+model output (trimmed):
```
<USER_PROMPT> ... [long history ~1795 tokens] <INSTR_START> Please summarize the previous chat concisely. <INSTR_END>
<MODEL_OUTPUT> ... summary starts then abruptly repeats earlier user text and stops. No "Please summarize" result.
```
Seems like model stomps on the instruction or it never reaches attention layer.

anika patel: hmm. Does kv-offset in traces show any wraparound or slot re-use? Also which kernel/quant pipeline was used for that host?

josh chen: grabbed a trace from the eval runner: sequence numbers jump after token seq 1792 -> 0 on the same session id. Looks like a per-session seqnum reset. snippet: `seq: 1789, 1790, 1791, 1792, 0, 1, 2`

infra-bot: deploy-bot: deployed image redwood/serve:quantized-v2-rc3 to cluster inference-dedicated-us-west2 at 2026-03-19T02:15:12Z

tom rivera: RC3 switched to a different KV packing layout (slot-rotation) to shave memory. Could be an indexing bug when wrap happens. Also changed fused attention kernel in that build.

anika patel: If seqnum resets to 0 mid-session, KV cache reindex will read wrong embeddings -> instruction tokens effectively lost. We should check session id collision / reset path in replay code and gating at call boundary.

josh chen: quick repro command I used locally: `./tools/repro_eval --model quantized-v2-rc3 --eval context-pulse --seed 42 --dump-trace trace.json`

maya singh: thanks. trace.json attached in the eval run (linked in the CI artifact).

anika patel: initial quick binary bisect: rc2 (old kv-layout) -> no failures; rc3 -> failures. So regression likely from the kv packing change.

tom rivera: I'll spin up a small repro on dedicated-gpu-1, run the replay with `--disable-slot-rotation` and `--enable-kernel-fallback` to confirm. If that fixes it, we revert slot-rotation or gate it behind a runtime flag.

josh chen: also saw some sessions where prompt-length calculation used bytes not tokens in the boundary check. Could be unrelated but worth verifying.

maya singh: Priority: P1 for nightly quality. Tom, can you run the repro and post results here? If confirmed, we'll cut a hotfix + rollback plan.

tom rivera: on it, ETA ~45m.

eval-bot: nightly-eval: context-pulse — baseline 96.8% -> rc3 84.5% (regression +12.3pp). Failures correlate with sessions > 1600 tokens.

josh chen: if anyone needs quick access to the eval runner logs: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/nightly/5482/trace.json (read-only)

maya singh: thanks everyone. tagging @oncall-ml for visibility. I'll open a bug with reproducer and link this thread. :exclamation: :eyes:

anika patel: one more note — add a unit test for seqnum wrap handling + a small fuzz harness to exercise long-history sessions. That prevented similar regressions last year.

josh chen: ack. I'll add the test after tom confirms repro.

.tom rivera: repro finished, disabling slot-rotation fixes the sample: instruction preserved and summary generated. Confirmed root cause = slot-rotation index arithmetic overflow when seq wraps. Creating PR to patch arithmetic + add tests.

maya singh: awesome. please include a short blurb in the release notes and notify customer success for any impacted customers.

josh chen: :thumbsup:

anika patel: great catch. closing loop once PR lands and nightly re-run shows green.

maya singh: thanks team.
